instagram.caption:
Apple’s iPhones in China will now run Alibaba’s Qwen AI instead of Apple’s own system.

Apple Intelligence was previously blocked by Chinese regulators. This partnership makes it locally compliant, so the features finally work under national rules.

If you publish or create content for a Chinese audience, the underlying AI model changed. Your tools may now prioritize compliance over capability.
